hypothesis.hypothesis_text: Modify one source-grounded bounded calculation so repeated equivalent work is performed once while preserving the public callable and returned value.
hypothesis.target_weakness: The visible generic function repeats an equivalent bounded calculation on every invocation.
hypothesis.expected_effect: Preserve the returned value while reducing repeated local work in the generic subject.

research_basis.material_delta: This candidate changes one repeated calculation rather than replaying a prior implementation.
alternatives_considered: Move the calculation to a helper without changing its frequency.
research_basis.observable_prediction: The public callable returns the same values while executing the calculation fewer times.
research_basis.falsification_condition: Reject the candidate if any public result changes or the calculation count does not decrease.
